text:
maria: quick note 1 reproduced a provisional vs confirmed delta after a model handoff + ingress retry. looks like two provisional ledger rows for same logical request. anyone seen this pattern?
josh: can you share the request id + condensed logs?
maria: pasted a redacted snippet below: 
```
2026-03-20T18:03:12.011Z request=ryq-11 sess=s-7 event=ledger_write scope=provisional tokens=16
2026-03-20T18:03:12.034Z request=ryq-11 sess=s-7 event=ledger_write scope=provisional tokens=16
2026-03-20T18:03:12.100Z request=ryq-11 sess=s-7 event=ledger_confirm tokens=32
```
weird part: billing UI shows only one confirmed charge (32) but provisional-series on infra dashboards has two blips.
priya: probable root: prefetch populates router side KV, eviction race + ingress retry causes duplicate provisional writes. we should have a router-generated ephemeral id (fingerprint) that gets included with ledger writes so ledger can idempotently dedupe.
josh: agree on router fingerprint. deduping on (session,seq) would be simpler, but some SDKs don't set seq. ephemeral-fingerprint at ingress -> thread through routing sounds robust. perf note: adding fingerprint to every packet is cheap (uuid4) but we should avoid extra RPS to ledger for dedupe checks; prefer a single conditional write with IF NOT EXISTS semantics.
sam: another vector: toolcall truncation path. If a toolcall short-circuits and confirms provisional tokens earlier than the retry completes, you can end up with two provisional entries and two confirms (or one confirm + one stray provisional). i wrote a small harness that forces a toolcall TTL and immediate retry to repro.
maria: can you drop that harness? mine is flaky. also i deployed a temporary canary tweak: router.retry_window=40ms and heartbeat_grace=220ms for the canary pool which reduced the noise by ~60%.
billing-bot: NOTICE: provisional_confirm_delta spike +98% @2026-03-20T18:03Z (route=/v1/complete model=redwood-xl customer=zephyr) :warning:
priya: console UX thing 1 current console only shows confirmed (billed) tokens in per-route waterfalls. ops needs provisional vs confirmed breakdown (timeseries + per-route waterfall + quick link to trace). otherwise triage is painful.
josh: i'll sketch a small console panel for "provisional tokens" per route and wire trace links. filed INF-1278 to track this plus the ledger dedupe infra work.
maria: action items: (1) josh prototype console row + trace link (2) infra: add router ingress fingerprint + ledger conditional write (3) ops: keep canary retry_window lowered and increase kv retention for impacted customers until dedupe lands. will reconvene in 24h.
